lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for the Faroe Islands region. The dataset represents approximately 78% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 3 years and recent updates within the last 6 months. Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage) with standardized OSM attributes including building type, structural characteristics, and address information.
